message.content: {"note_claim": "The extended ISS stay for Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the spacecraft's maneuvering thrusters on the Boeing Starliner, not a toilet malfunction.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The spacecraft that took them there - Boeing's Starliner – has faced technical issues which has halted their return to Earth", "reason": "The page directly attributes the astronauts' extended stay to technical issues with the Boeing Starliner, including specific mentions of thruster system problems, and contains no mention of any toilet malfunction."}

parsed.note_claim: The extended ISS stay for Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the spacecraft's maneuvering thrusters on the Boeing Starliner, not a toilet malfunction.
